transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because my mood has been completely all over the place for about a year now. I'll feel incredibly happy and on top of the world, but then I suddenly get super angry and irritated over the smallest things. I also just have way too much energy and can't seem to slow down.

During those times when you feel on top of the world and have excess energy, have you ever experienced a period lasting at least a week where your behavior was so extreme that you required hospitalization or were unable to function at work or in your daily life?
I'm not really sure if my behavior has ever been extreme enough to need hospitalization. But these feelings of having way too much energy and shifting moods have been happening for about a year now.

Even if you didn't require hospitalization, were there any instances where your high energy or mood changes were so intense that they significantly interfered with your ability to work, go to school, or maintain your personal relationships?

Yes, they definitely have over the past year. My high energy makes me start way too many projects at once, which makes it impossible to actually focus and finish my work. On top of that, my sudden mood swings make me snap at people, which has really strained my relationships with my family and coworkers.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever experienced a stretch of at least four consecutive days where your mood was elevated or irritable for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, I definitely have. In fact, these periods of intense happiness, high energy, and irritability have been happening on and off for about a year now. When they hit, they usually last much longer than just four days at a time.

In addition to these periods of high energy and irritability, have you also experienced times where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in the things you usually enjoy for two weeks or more?
No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling sad, hopeless, or losing interest in things. My main concern has really just been this high energy and irritability.

During those high energy periods, have you ever felt so 'on top of the world' that you felt invincible, stopped needing sleep for days at a time, or engaged in risky behaviors like impulsive spending or reckless activities?

I definitely feel on top of the world with an intense happiness, like I have overflowing energy to do absolutely anything. I'm not sure about needing less sleep or doing risky things, but I just have this constant need to keep moving and starting multiple projects at once.

Has anyone around you—like a friend, family member, or coworker—ever expressed significant concern that your behavior was becoming erratic, dangerous, or completely out of character during those high-energy periods?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't paid much attention to whether others have expressed concern about my behavior during those times.
Can you recall if any of these high-energy periods lasted for at least seven consecutive days, even if they didn't lead to hospitalization or obvious danger?
Yes, absolutely. Those high-energy periods definitely last much longer than seven consecutive days. They usually go on for weeks or even months at a time, on and off, over this past year.
During these weeks-long periods of high energy, have you ever experienced a significant decrease in your need for sleep, such as feeling fully rested after only three hours or less of sleep?
I haven't really noticed a significant decrease in my need for sleep during those times. It's not really something I've paid close attention to, so I'm not sure about that.

During these weeks-long periods of high energy, have you ever engaged in any behavior that was so out of character or reckless that it put you or your finances in serious trouble, such as spending large amounts of money you couldn't afford or engaging in dangerous activities?
No, I haven't really experienced anything like that. I haven't gotten into any financial trouble or done anything dangerous during those times.
